competitions.result: Semi-final — lost 2–1 to Aston Villa at Wembley.
Semi-final — lost 2–1 on aggregate to Chelsea.
Champions League group stage — eliminated before the knockout rounds.
Europa League round of 32 — lost 5–4 on penalties to Beşiktaş after a 1–1 aggregate draw.

in.note: Immediately loaned back to Lille for the season.

overview: Liverpool finished sixth in the Premier League with 62 points, eight behind fourth-placed Manchester United. Brendan Rodgers’ side scored 52 league goals, compared with 101 the previous season. Luis Suárez left for Barcelona, while Adam Lallana, Emre Can, Dejan Lovren and Mario Balotelli were among the arrivals.

The return to the Champions League ended in the group stage, followed by a Europa League exit on penalties against Beşiktaş. Liverpool reached both domestic cup semi-finals but lost to Chelsea in the League Cup and Aston Villa in the FA Cup. Steven Gerrard led the scoring with 13 goals in his final campaign. His last home appearance ended in a 3–1 defeat by Crystal Palace, and he scored Liverpool’s goal in the 6–1 loss at Stoke that closed the season. He left for LA Galaxy after 710 appearances for the club.
